dict.string: MioCal needs to access your calendar to display meetings and events.
MioCal needs full access to your calendar to sync and manage events, and subscribe to external calendars.
MioCal needs your location to calculate sunrise and sunset times, Islamic prayer times, and Hebrew Shabbat times.
MioCal uses your location to provide accurate astronomical information (sunrise and sunset times, moon phases) and religious times (prayer times, Shabbat).
